title: Chadwick Boseman Story; The
description:
The Chadwick Boseman Story
Chadwick Boseman's performances elevated the biographical genre, he became the definition of bringing heroes to life. He knew from the very beginning his life would be short, with that he made the decision to be dedicated to his work and living his life like everyone else. Knowing how precious every moment was. He made an everlasting impression on everyone he worked with and especially on the people who admired his talents. He was always acting, always writing, always kind. He not only played a superhero. He became a hero.
